content: A cinematic, 8K video sequence. It starts with a close-up of a fierce female warrior with sharp features, wearing an intricate black and gold futuristic armor helmet that automatically closes, concealing her face. She has large, glowing golden mechanical angel wings. She raises her hand, summoning a swirling circle of golden energy, then draws a glowing, radiant energy sword. Cut to a wide shot from behind as she faces five red-eyed, hulking shadow monsters on a dark, wet industrial metal platform. An epic battle ensues: she swings her glowing sword, cutting down the monsters with fast-paced, fluid action. The camera cuts to a close-up of her golden high-heeled boots stepping through the puddles as the defeated monsters dissolve into dark matter. The camera pulls back to reveal a colossal, terrifying horned demon giant towering over her in the background, its eyes and chest glowing red. Une bataille épique s'ensuit : elle brandit son épée lumineuse, abattant les monstres avec une action rapide et fluide.
